name: Franklin County, MA
findings: Franklin County has 345 nonprofit organizations. 124 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 106 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Franklin County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 19 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 2 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 38 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
